name: Vampirina: Teenage Vampire
description: Follow a tween vampire girl who leaves the safety of Transylvania to attend a performing arts boarding school. Living amongst humans for the first time, she pursues her passion for music while keeping her vampire identity a secret, something that’s made more challenging when her overprotective father charges an overzealous ghost to live with her at the school.

videos.title: First Year to Watch
videos.overview: As Vee arrives at Wilson Hall, she learns that performing arts boarding school might have more challenges than she thought. Demi vows to protect Vee from Van Helsings.

videos.title: First Day of School
videos.overview: Vee's plans to have an amazing first day of school are threatened by a dire warning from the Vampire Council. Demi continues his search for Van Helsings.

videos.title: First Dance
videos.overview: In the lead up to the Wilson Hall Welcome Dance, Vee and Elijah struggle with power imbalances. Meanwhile, Sophie searches for her DJ persona.

videos.title: First Parents Day
videos.overview: When Parents Day sneaks up on Vee and Elijah, they struggle to keep their parents from meeting. Meanwhile, Demi learns how to disguise his ghostly form.

videos.title: First Enemy
videos.overview: Vee and Sophie try to impress Elijah's sister Moriah, who invites the friends over for dinner. Meanwhile, Demi and Britney form an unlikely bond.

videos.title: First Club
videos.overview: Vee, Sophie and Britney audition for "The Spotlights," an exclusive all-girls club at Wilson Hall. Meanwhile, Elijah and Demi try out being roommates.

videos.title: First Halloween
videos.overview: Vee wishes on a Blood Moon to re-do Halloween with the help of a Moon Imp. Elijah helps Demi prove that he can still be scary in his "real boy" form.

videos.title: First Nightmare
videos.overview: A visit from a gargoyle keeps Elijah from telling Vee a secret. Meanwhile, Sophie and Demi use a skeleton toy to help Elijah with a dance assignment.

videos.title: First Final
videos.overview: When Vee asks for Demi's help on a class presentation, his ghostly secret is put in danger. Meanwhile, Elijah is invited to an underground rap cypher.

videos.title: First Holiday
videos.overview: When Vee's at a loss for what to get her Secret Santa recipient, she enlists some Transylvanian help. Meanwhile, Elijah and Demi struggle to find the perfect gift for Sophie.

videos.title: First Vampire Friend
videos.overview: When Vee's fritzing knocks out a fang, an unexpected chain of events draws her and Britney closer- just as Elijah and Sophie race to fix the situation.

videos.title: First Heartbeat
videos.overview: Vee reconnects with Billie and gets a surprise visit from the Vampire Council. Meanwhile, Britney is mad at Elijah for forgetting their plans.

videos.title: First Power Trip
videos.overview: Vee, Sophie, Elijah and Britney compete to be Millie Eyelash's opening act. Meanwhile, Demi is forced to protect Dean Merriweather.

videos.title: First Pet
videos.overview: While Vee struggles to tell her friends her diagnosis, Sophie brings her pet bunny to school. Meanwhile, Demi and Britney invite Dean Merriweather to join their a cappella group.

videos.title: First Villain
videos.overview: When Sophie directs Vee and Elijah in a romantic scene, a new student from Transylvania, Lucien, disrupts the chemistry. Meanwhile Demi and Britney have kitchen duties.

videos.title: First Full Vampire
videos.overview: Lucien plots as Sophie, Elijah and Demi... reflect on their situation. Britney tries to meet Millie Eyelash and Vee learns a new way to channel her power.

videos.title: Second To Breathe
videos.overview: Vee and Demi save Zach and Vick.
